A sweeping camera move across Figma's interface highlighting frames and layers.

Demonstrate creating a new frame, then drawing a rectangle inside it.

beats.text: Figma logo appears, introducing the design platform.
Camera sweeps across Figma's interface, revealing frames and layers in motion.
Still shot shows designers' avatars collaborating live on a shared file.
Dynamic scroll highlights Figma's asset library with components and styles.
Click the frame tool, draw a frame, then select the rectangle shape to place inside.
Start designing today—visit figma.com to begin your first project now.

voiceover.script: Figma logo appears, introducing the design platform. Camera sweeps across Figma's interface, revealing frames and layers in motion.
